evidence.reason: Outbox.spool() validates the event and then durably writes canonical(value) to pending without any record-size admission check. A review whose payload.paths list is large or whose path/reason strings are long can therefore pass schema validation and be spooled as a pending record larger than the ledger's RECORD_BYTES limit. Since GitLedger.publish() rejects such pending records before pushing, the oversized record remains pending and blocks later valid records. This is an implementation liveness bug in existing spool/publish behavior, not a proposal to add a new approval or protection requirement; rejecting oversized records at spool is a routine fix.
